description: This is an implementation of the PermissionService interface in a Java Spring application, managing permissions-related business logic, including CRUD operations and group associations in a sales management system.

classes.name: PermissionServiceImpl
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing permission management operations such as retrieving, deleting, and listing permissions, as well as managing permissions associated with groups.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Placeholder for saving or updating a Permission entity.

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Deletes a permission after nullifying its group associations, with error handling.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Fetches a list of permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of permissions matching specified criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a group from a permission's associated groups.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions.
